newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zodiac helped by brokers' comments.
newsitem.headline: Zodiac helped by brokers' comments.

text.p: Shares in Zodiac, a manufacturer of plane evacuation slides and dinghies, continued their rise on Monday on positive comments from brokerage firms, dealers said.
SBC-Warburg raised its rating on the stock to buy from hold, citing Zodiac's strong fundamentals.

The share, which rose 0.81 percent on Friday after the company forecast profit growth of at least 15 percent for 1996/97, was up another 39 francs at 1,539 at 1230 GMT. The CAC-40 index was up one percent.
Traders said broker Cheuvreux de Virieu said in its morning comment that it confirmed its positive rating on the stock.
Traders said Zodiac's aeronautics activities were also seen helped by the announcement over the weekend of a merger between Boeing and McDonnell Douglas.
